name: Zach Andrews

bio.statement: Troutdale's city directory lists Zach Andrews as a city councilor.
On his city council page, Andrews says his professional background is in renewable energy and sustainable technology.
bio.excerpt: My professional background is in the renewable energy and sustainable technology industries

bio.statement: His city council page says he has served on the Troutdale Planning Commission.
bio.excerpt: I have had the honor of serving on the Troutdale Planning Commission

positions.statement: On his city council page, Andrews lists keeping costs down and fiscal responsibility among his goals.
positions.excerpt: Some of my goals are to continue working solutions for keeping costs down and being fiscally responsible

positions.statement: His city council page says he cares about the healthy development and growth of Troutdale.
positions.excerpt: I care deeply about the healthy development and growth of our city

collection_notes: Incumbent councilor (at-large). Troutdale "Meet Us" page lists Mayor David Ripma and councilors Carol Allen, Jesse Davidson, John Leamy, Glenn White, Geoffrey Wunn and Zach Andrews; three at-large four-year seats are on the Nov 2026 ballot. Step-5 queries used "Zach Andrews" Troutdale because the bare name is common. KGW/KATU results about a former MMA fighter named Zachary Lee Andrews were NOT attributed; nothing ties that person to this candidate. Statement filed (index M-68) but online copy is a scan.
